judge_panel.reason: The paper explicitly states: 'The loser update is applied only when Np > 1 to avoid division by zero and unstable singleton collapse.' This directly addresses and resolves the reviewer's concern about division by zero for singleton clusters.

The paper explicitly addresses this concern in Sec. 2.2: after defining the loser update "wp ← wp − 1/(Np − 1) (xi − wp)," it states, "The loser update is applied only when Np > 1 to avoid division by zero and unstable singleton collapse." This directly resolves the claimed division-by-zero risk.
The paper explicitly states in Section 2.2 that 'The loser update is applied only when N_p > 1 to avoid division by zero and unstable singleton collapse', contradicting the reviewer's claim.
